messages:
eli: Heads-up — Large enterprise customer (FinCo) asked for 50ms p95 for short-embeddings path (<=64 tokens). Can we hit this with current kernel/quant mix?
maya: That's tight. With current float16 kernels and no quant we see ~80-100ms p95 on A100 for 64-tokens. Prefetch/KV cache could push it down for repeated prompts.
zack: Customer will hit with single-request low QPS too; they want predictable latency. That kills batching gains.
sophia: We can do a two-prong approach: 1) kernel micro-optimizations for short sequences, 2) aggressive KV prefix caching with warmup traces, and 3) calibrated int8 quant path for the embedding model.
anita: int8 helps cost but we need to nail regressions. What's acceptable on embeddings?
eli: Proposal for launch criteria: p50<=20ms, p95<=50ms for <=64-token single-request on Dedicated node profile; embedding cosine delta mean <0.001 and max <0.002 on our eval set. Canary 5% traffic for 48h with automatic rollback gate.
perf-bot: benchmark queued: perf-run-22355-shortseq-v2 (ETA ~2h)
maya: Also add a fallback routing rule: if quant path fails quality gating, route to f16 kernel with auto-failover.
zack: Ops note: Dedicated capacity needs GPU pinning and prewarmed instances to avoid cold-start jitter. Add as task.
sophia: Kernel work estimate: short-seq fused-kernel + reduce dispatch overhead -> 2w for prototype, 1w for benching and docs.
anita: Quant team estimate: 3w for calibrated int8 + eval harness + automated regression tests.
eli: Prioritization question — product wants this next quarter for customer commit. Tradeoffs: kernel+kv (faster wins) vs int8 (longer but lowers unit cost). Opinions?
maya: If timeline is tight, do kernel + KV caching first to hit latency SLO, then roll out int8 for cost after.
jason: Customer-facing rollout expectations: we can promise the SLO under Dedicated with prewarming + pinned nodes. Need explicit config spec for customers.
eli: Spec draft snippet:
```
model_profile: em-small-v2
deployment: dedicated
node_profile: c2.large-gpu-prewarm
quant_mode: optional
kv_prefetch: enabled
slo: p95_64_tokens <= 50ms
```
sophia: Observability: include per-request trace id, kernel_tag, quant_flag, kv_hit boolean in logs/metrics.
perf-bot: perf-run completed: p95 46ms with kernel+kv warm path on bench cluster; p95 72ms without prewarm. Artifacts: s3://perf/artifacts/22355
zack: Good signal. What's the embedding regression after int8?
anita: Preliminary quant run: embedding cosine delta mean=0.0009, max=0.0032 on our small eval set. Max exceeds the proposed launch threshold; needs calibration.
maya: Can we gate quant under routing policy? e.g., enable for non-critical tenants first and do gradual rollout.
eli: yes — add routing policy: quant_enabled for low-fidelity buckets, default to f16 for critical customers.
jason: Action items:
- sophia: spike fused short-seq kernel (owner) — due in 2w
- anita: int8 calibration + expanded eval (owner) — due in 3w
- maya: KV prefetch ops runbook + prewarm config (owner) — due in 1w
- zack: Dedicated capacity config + pinning doc (owner) — due in 1w
- eli: write customer commit note + SLO wording (owner) — due in 3d
maya: I'll add these to the roadmap board and prioritize as sprint bets.
sophia: One more ask — add perf gating in console: "slo_health" indicator so can block canary promotion automatically.
eli: Agreed. If gating isn't present, block canary promotion.
jason: +1 :thumbsup: 
perf-bot: created tickets PERF-22355 (kernel+kv) and QNT-22356 (int8-cal). Links: https://redwood/Tickets/PERF-22355
eli: Thanks team. I'll sync with product later today and confirm the commit date.
maya: Thanks all — dropping meeting notes and the spec draft in the roadmap board. :white_check_mark:
